# AI Insider — AI automation & agents studio

AI Insider builds production-ready AI automation for business: AI agents, chatbots (RAG), voice agents, and workflow automation (including n8n). The primary language is Ukrainian; English is secondary.

## Languages
- Ukrainian (primary): https://www.aiinsider.it.com/uk/
- English: https://www.aiinsider.it.com/en/

## What we do (topics)
- AI automation for business
- AI agents (tool-use)
- AI chatbots for business (RAG knowledge assistants)
- AI voice agents (calling, qualification, booking)
- n8n workflow automation (integrations, routing, alerts)
- AI-driven marketing systems (content pipelines, personalization)
- CRM automation (HubSpot/Salesforce/Pipedrive)
